overview:
Networking – A computer network is a set of computers sharing resources located on or provided by network nodes. The computers use common communication protocols over digital interconnections to communicate with each other. Through Computer networks, users can share their files, printer, or another device with each other and run. There are 3 elements of a computer network
With the networking huge amount of work can be shortened. Network engineers have huge demand now. Because every reputed and big companies use networking for fast and convenience.
This course offers you the opportunity to become a successful networker by learning advanced networking from the basics of Network Engineer, CCNA, MTCNA, and RHCE.
